OPT_f_configuration.rule: OPT_f(x) iff x in F and |f(x)-f*| <= fl((c_f*eps)*fl(Lambda_ref+max(|f(x)|,|f*|)))

diagnostics.OPT_f_status: NON-PRIMARY DIAGNOSTIC. X* above is the primary §3.1 exact-equality set. D015's OPT_f is the downstream decoded-candidate predicate; it is reported here because it is now computable, not as a substitute.

explicitly_excluded.ADNYE-002: not produced by this script. Under D014's approved chronology G3-C emits it after a sidecar/schema verification of ADNYE-001 with Lambda_ref != 0 — NOT after final resolved-branch acceptance, which is impossible before ADNYE-002 exists.

governing_specification.ddof_convention: population standard deviation, ddof = 0, stated with the number as D008 requires; a reporting convention, not a decision D008 could have approved.
governing_specification.feasible_set: F = { x in {0,1}^20 : sum_i x_i = K, n_j(x) <= C for all j = 1..4, p^T x <= B }
governing_specification.ledger: FROZEN_MATH_SPEC.md §5.2 canonical binary64 ledger: no FMA, no reassociation, no library dot product, no pow; accumulators start at +0.0; mu terms in increasing i, then quad terms row-major (i,k).
governing_specification.objective: f(x) = -mu^T x + kappa_risk * x^T Sigma x   [FROZEN_MATH_SPEC.md §3.1]
governing_specification.optimum: f* = min_{x in F} f(x); X* = {x in F : f(x) = f*}   [§3.1]
